verdict.rationale: Bolt.new generates full-stack apps from prompts, including frontend UI plus backend logic via Node.js servers, npm libraries, third-party API integration, and Supabase-backed database/auth/edge functions, all driven from chat prompts (bolt-gh-2, bolt-gh-3, bolt-docs-8, bolt-docs-22, bolt-docs-27). Community reports corroborate building functional full-stack apps (database, nav, recipes) from prompts in minutes (bolt-comm-4, bolt-comm-3). missing for 10: no first-party doc explicitly frames 'one prompt generates both frontend and backend simultaneously' as a named feature, and some community critique notes backend is outsourced to Supabase rather than custom-generated logic (bolt-comm-11).
